items.prompt: How should later evaluation rows be centered?

options.text: By a mean recomputed from the full train+test dataset
By each row itself, making every row0
options.why: That changes the representation and destroys the intended deviations.

options.text: By whichever mean gives the best final test score
options.why: That tunes the final evaluation data.

options.text: By the frozen training mean with the trained scaling/basis
options.why: The same learned transform is applied without refitting.

items.explanation: PCA is a fitted preprocessing step, so its mean/scales/basis belong to the training boundary.
